title: Temple with a Ruined Altar
name: scene_temple_altar
scene_summary: The great hall of an ancient temple seen from above, open to the sky: one enormous undivided hall, a broad processional aisle running its length to a ruined altar on a stepped platform, with rows of benches either side.
render_details: Worn grey flagstones, a paler processional aisle down the middle, broken column drums lying across the floor, rows of dark stone benches, a cracked altar slab, a colossal broken statue, iron braziers with live coals, dust and grit

rooms.label: Temple Hall
rooms.description: One single enormous undivided hall of worn grey flagstone. There are no interior walls anywhere inside it: no partition, no screen and no smaller room - it is one continuous floor from one outer wall to the other, broken only by free-standing columns and by the fallen drums of the columns that no longer stand.

annotations.label: Processional Aisle
annotations.description: A broad straight aisle of paler stone running the length of the hall from the entrance to the foot of the altar steps, worn smooth and clear of everything

annotations.label: The Altar
annotations.description: A ruined altar of pale stone standing on a platform of three broad steps, its slab cracked across the middle, the steps running the full width of the platform and seen from directly above as three straight bands

annotations.label: Broken Statue
annotations.description: A colossal statue of a forgotten god fallen full length on the floor behind the altar, seen from straight above, its head smashed away and one arm broken off and lying in pieces beside it

annotations.label: West Benches
annotations.description: Rows of long low stone benches standing in ranks facing the aisle, several of them overturned and two cracked across

annotations.label: East Benches
annotations.description: Rows of long low stone benches standing in ranks facing the aisle, several of them overturned and two cracked across

annotations.label: Collapsed Floor
annotations.description: A ragged hole where the floor has fallen away into darkness, its edges broken flagstone, with one narrow ledge of intact floor left along one side wide enough to cross in single file

annotations.label: Side Chapel
annotations.description: A small side chapel opening off the hall through a half-collapsed wall, a dark passage leading away at the back of it

annotations.label: Bronze Doors
annotations.description: A pair of massive closed bronze doors set in the wall, seen from directly above as two flat panels flush with the stone
